candidate.baseline: MMQ selected down -> sorted-lane weighted sum into BF16 routed_output -> shared projections -> BF16 add
candidate.candidate: MMQ selected down -> shared projections -> exact sorted-lane weighted sum plus shared BF16 add composite
candidate.math: Preserve ten slot-order F32 FMAs, round the selected sum to BF16, add the BF16 shared output, then round the final output to BF16.
candidate.physical_change: Reuse the already registered exact grouped-combine primitive on the MMQ route, eliminating one 512x3072 BF16 write/read round trip and one launch in every sparse layer.
candidate.fallback: The registered weighted-lanes sum and BF16 add primitives remain the numerically equivalent unfused chain.

correctness.red: The MMQ-combine policy test failed because the runtime had no _should_fuse_grouped_weighted_sum decision and always materialized routed_output before shared projections.
correctness.green: The policy test passes and both production-shape Q4_K and Q6_K MoE oracle cases are BF16-byte identical to a forced-unfused MMQ combine.

matched_ab.protocol: seven counter-rotated one-owner pp512 pairs after one 128-row warmup per mode; model load excluded
matched_ab.interpretation: Absolute medians cross because of within-run drift; the predeclared paired view is positive but noisy. Retention relies on exactness plus the independently traced physical sub-window improvement.
